mil7.7.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, pavanassa pañca angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni pañca angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.7.4:1.2: Yathā mahārāja pavanaṃ nāma asucijanaṃ paṭicchādeti,
mil7.7.4:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena paresaṃ aparaddhaṃ khalitaṃ paṭicchādetabbaṃ, na vivaritabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja pavanassa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja pavanaṃ suññaṃ pacurajanehi,
mil7.7.4:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena rāga-dosa-moha-māna-diṭṭhijālehi sabbehi ca kilesehi suññena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja pavanassa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja pavanaṃ vivittaṃ janasambādharahitaṃ,
mil7.7.4:3.2: evameva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehi anariyehi pavivittena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja pavanassa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ maharāja pavanaṃ santaṃ parisuddhaṃ,
mil7.7.4:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena santena parisuddhena bhavitabbaṃ, nibbutena pahīnamānena pahīnamakkhena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:4.3: Idaṃ mahārāja pavanassa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja pavanaṃ ariyajanasaṃsevitaṃ,
mil7.7.4:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena ariyajanasaṃsevitena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:5.3: Idaṃ mahārāja pavanassa pañcamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.7.4:5.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Saṃyuttanikāyavare:
